role: third sequential exposed mechanistic-synthetic development family; never validation, EPA test, primary, or confirmation
objective: Test whether a causal per-user budget on total optimization exposure across overlapping lag windows closes the remaining slow-drift gate while preserving every original margin.

development_history.v3_disposition: fixed-window budget1 improved drift attenuation to 0.39 percent but every budget failed the unchanged 20 percent drift gate
development_history.budget_derivation: multiply the previously registered per-window budgets 1,2,4 by lag+1=7, the maximum number of rolling solves that can reuse one timely record; chosen before v4 outcomes

inputs.reuse: byte-identical v2 prediction inputs; no world or transport regeneration
inputs.truth_use: separate scoring capability loaded only after all v4 candidate predictions for a job are written and hashed
inputs.exposure: same exposed v2/v3 worlds reused for sequential development; no independence or p-value claim

controls.reuse_rule: verify every v2 result, prediction and manifest hash in the v4 source lock; never recompute an unchanged control
controls.same_information: candidate fingerprints the unmodified raw prediction view before causal reweighting; all controls receive that identical information

selection_and_exit.rule: A budget is eligible only if every unchanged aggregate gate and every invariant passes. Select at most one by minimum worst normalized loss, then smaller lifetime budget, runtime, and ID.
selection_and_exit.no_feasible_candidate: Close v4 and retain all adverse outcomes; no budget, gate, world, cap, delta, lag, covariance, forcing, or control change inside this family.
selection_and_exit.downstream: A nomination authorizes only a separately frozen validation protocol. It cannot open EPA tests, primary, or confirmation.

runtime.resume: only missing hash-identical candidate predictions; no replacement seed
